resources.string: ParamWorker is a design tool. Check the dimensions, tolerances and strength of your parts yourself before manufacturing; the app is not intended for safety-critical components. Statutory liability for intent, gross negligence and injury to life, body or health remains unaffected.

ParamWorker has no servers of its own, no ads, no analytics or tracking tools and no user account. Internet access is used only to buy ParamWorker Pro via Google Play (Google Play Billing). Your projects do not leave the device unless you export or share them. They are stored locally; depending on your system settings, Android may include them in a device backup. Feedback opens your email app.

When you buy, Google (Google Ireland / Google Commerce) processes payment and purchase data as an independent controller under its own privacy policy. The app receives only the purchase status and the receipt (order number, purchase token) to unlock Pro and stores them locally. Google’s Billing library may send technical diagnostic data to Google.
“Send feedback” only opens your email app with a prepared message (app version, device, Android version); nothing is sent until you send it yourself.
This app uses the following free software. Thanks to everyone involved!
Geometry kernel (B-rep: bodies, faces, edges, fillets)
GNU LGPL 2.1 with Open CASCADE exception

Shipped unmodified as separate libraries (libTK*.so) and therefore replaceable with a self-built version. On request to kb-it-services@outlook.de we will send you the complete source code of this OCCT version including build instructions free of charge (for at least three years after you received this app version). These libraries may be modified for your own use and reverse-engineered for debugging such modifications (LGPL 2.1 § 6). Contains DELABELLA (MIT), flex (BSD), strtod by David M. Gay/Lucent and Unicode code (Unicode, Inc.).
Solid computation in the script editor (OpenSCAD)
